_readme: Verified learner testimonials. Every entry MUST be a real quote from a real person who gave permission, referencing a course/product that exists on the site under its real name. Fields: quote (required), name (as the person wants it shown), role (anonymised is fine), course (display name), courseUrl (optional), lang (en/hi/ta/bn/mr/te), pages (which pages show it: premium|coaching|workshops|dojos|products). The site renders nothing while this list is empty.
